# Service Refactoring TODO

This document lists all files that currently use manually written services instead of autogenerated services from `src/renderer/src/services/cradle/`.

## Overview

The UI should be refactored to use the autogenerated OpenAPI services located in:
- `src/renderer/src/services/cradle/apis/` - Autogenerated API classes
- `src/renderer/src/services/cradle/models/` - Autogenerated models

Instead of the manually written services in:
- `src/renderer/src/services/[serviceName]/` - Manual implementations

- Some services may have slightly different method signatures

## Architecture Improvements

### Token Management (Completed)
- **AuthProvider** now provides tokens to ApiProvider and exposes `updateAccessToken()` method
- **ApiProvider** automatically handles:
  - Token placement in requests via `accessToken` configuration
  - Automatic token refresh when expiring (within 60 seconds)
  - Updates AuthProvider with new access token after refresh
  - Converts form-encoded bodies to JSON when `Content-Type: application/json`
  - Filters out `undefined` values from request bodies

### Migration Complete: authReqService → UsersApi
All authentication endpoints now use the autogenerated `UsersApi`:
- Login with 2FA support
- User registration
- Email confirmation
- Password reset request
- Password reset confirmation

The manual `authReqService` and `axiosInstance` for auth can be safely removed.
